structuredContent.body:
Adopt the published Builds 4.44.2 / Platform v1.3.0 tuple for blocking disposable package integration, using immutable Builds executor `ae68c59bd2f4145a23ccf68c3711f98eaf62195f` in ordinary CI and the registered lifecycle baseline. Preserve all 15 isolated projects, independent owner gates, incoming source selections, publication controls and existing budgets.

Enable exact Memories 3.0.23 refresh and FrontComposer 4.7.6 UI/readiness capabilities in the owning finite selectors. Keep unknown-package fallbacks and strict served-asset identity checks. The native suite retains real Parties/Tenants/Memories persistence assertions, adds anonymous gateway 401 coverage and preserves bounded source/owner-bound SDK diagnostics.

Exclude only the generated root `/.hexalith/builds-execution/` checkout from caller Git status. The previous hosted attempt passed all 15 isolated projects (6,330 tests) and all six independent jobs, then the unchanged source-clean proof refused before provisioning. A real Git regression reproduces that generated-checkout dirtiness and verifies the exact exclusion while tracked source/test/declaration/config changes and unrelated or lookalike untracked paths remain visible.

Validation: 449 affected .NET cases and 68 single-attempt local package browser cases passed for the capability correction. The generated-checkout correction passed five focused cases, an actual caller/Platform/Builds/helper layout check and signed 4.44.2 resource-free preparation; affected Release/package builds had zero warnings/errors. The hosted UI gate passed with one original configured retry; its first failure is retained.

Fresh complete hosted CI and the full trusted handoff/native execution with retained reports and exact cleanup remain required, followed by the three manual lifecycle scenarios. The new 401 fact has compiled and requires genuine hosted execution. Earlier failures remain preserved. No historical parity or candidate acceptance is claimed.
